title: FireweaveRemoteRegisterTarget
description: Vendor-neutral wire protocol for POST /v1/targets/register (ADR-0005). Auth: Authorization: Bearer <Fireweave project/runtime key>. Registers a targeting target — a user or a device — so flag rules can match on DURABLE properties. Registered properties are stored server-side; `attributes` on POST /v1/flags/evaluate override them for a single evaluation. No provider field names — fw-server maps to the connected provider.

targetingKey.description: The target's id — the SAME value later sent as targetingKey on evaluate and capture. fw-server scopes it to the calling project; two projects using the same raw id remain distinct targets.

kind.description: What is being registered. Recorded on the target so rules can distinguish user-level from device-level targeting.

environment.description: Client-declared environment (e.g. production, staging). Recorded on the target for environment-scoped rules.

properties.description: Durable targeting facts — plan, beta membership, region, device model. Keys prefixed `fw_` are reserved for server-authoritative tenancy stamps and are rejected/stripped.

targetingKey.description: Echoed back exactly as sent — the caller keeps using this value on evaluate.
